name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2163: A cross-family review of v2161 found four real defects and every one is fixed. THE TALLY INVENTED ITS DENOMINATORS: board_ownership emitted only foundLog, owned and setPieces, so uniquesTotal or 403 was a hardcoded guess sitting under a docstring that said never a guess, and runewords came back None on every real read while a comment claimed the total was asked of the board. The board is asked for its own totals now via its own roster functions, absent means None, and a guard asserts every key the tally reads is a key the board actually emits. MY OWN FIXTURE WAS BLIND: it injected runewordsMade, runewordsTotal and uniquesTotal that the JS never returned, so it pinned a roster of my invention while the real read fell through to the constant. A GUEST WORLD is refused even when the board is loaded, because an unclaimed board reads its own per-install keys which are empty by construction, so the tally would have published zeros under his nickname and they would have looked like facts. THE SERVER NEVER STORED THE FIELD: the beacon posted tally from v2157 and the Cloudflare worker built its record from a fixed key list that did not include it, so the tooltip could never have had data however well the console computed it. AND ONE SAMPLE IS NOT A RATE: done equals 1 at the three second floor with ten thousand frames to go projected EIGHT HOURS off a single cold probe, and a denominator undercounted by a swallowed listdir gave about 0s left while the read was plainly still running.
